prompt: Build the change-management section of our ITGC risk-and-control matrix for the billing system, including how the auditors will test it.
assertions: Produces an actual RCM structure: risk → control objective → control activity → type/frequency → owner → evidence → test approach

Covers the core change controls: pre-migration approval, documented testing evidence, developer/deployer segregation (no self-migration), emergency change path with after-the-fact approval, and configuration changes in the population
Describes population completeness (deployment log vs ticketing reconciliation) as part of testing
Gives test procedures with conventional sample sizes labelled as convention (e.g., 25 for frequent changes) and TOD walkthrough plus TOE distinction
Anchors why it matters: unauthorized billing-engine changes → misstated revenue (misstatement-anchored risk statements, not generic security risks)
